Load an installed pinned model

Source: R/model.R
load_model.Rd

load_model() reads an installed pinned model from the cache, verifies its files against the pinned sizes and hashes, and returns the model ready for inference: the tokenizer and the ONNX session (or, for the static potion-base-8M, its embedding table). An embedding model is defined by its network weights, its tokenizer, and the rules applied around them (pooling, input prefix, maximum input length); the package pins each supported model to an immutable Hugging Face revision with known file sizes and SHA-256 hashes, so that the same name always means the same model and the same text always receives the same embedding.

It never downloads anything; the files must first be installed with model_download(), and transformer models also need ONNX Runtime from install_runtime(). The result is an object of class sbert_model.

Most verbs accept a model name and load it themselves, keeping it for the rest of the session, so an explicit load_model() is needed mainly to set backend or threads. For a model outside the pinned list, use load_custom().

Usage

load_model(
  model = "all-MiniLM-L6-v2",
  cache_dir = default_cache_dir(),
  backend = "cpu",
  threads = 1L,
  verify = TRUE
)

Arguments

model

Name of a pinned model, as listed by models() (default "all-MiniLM-L6-v2").

cache_dir

Cache root (default cache_dir()).

backend

ONNX execution backend: "cpu" (default), "coreml", "cuda", "xnnpack" or "openvino", as accepted by onnxr::onnx_model().

threads

Number of inference threads, or "auto" for the machine's performance-core count (default 1). Results do not depend on the thread count; the gain in speed is modest and bounded by the number of performance cores. The default of one keeps runs within the two-core limit of check environments.

verify

Check file sizes and SHA-256 hashes before loading (default TRUE).

Value

An object of class sbert_model (class c("sbert_static_model", "sbert_model") for potion-base-8M): a list holding the model's identity (id, short_name, revision), its encoding settings (dimension, max_length, pooling, prefix), the backend and threads it runs with, and the loaded tokenizer and model. Pass it to the model argument of encode() and of the topic verbs; its print method shows the identity.

Conditions

sbert_unknown_model when model names no pinned model; sbert_model_not_installed when its files are missing; sbert_cache_invalid when they fail size or hash verification; sbert_runtime_missing when ONNX Runtime is not installed (transformer models only); sbert_missing_package when the static model is loaded without jsonlite; sbert_model_error when the tokenizer or model cannot be loaded.

See also

models() for the pinned models; model_download() and install_runtime() to install them; model_status() to check an installation; load_custom() for other Hugging Face models; encode() to use the model.

Examples

# The pinned models that load_model() accepts.
models()
#>                                    model dimensions max_tokens      languages
#> 1                       all-MiniLM-L6-v2        384        256        English
#> 2                      all-MiniLM-L12-v2        384        128        English
#> 3                paraphrase-MiniLM-L3-v2        384        128        English
#> 4              multi-qa-MiniLM-L6-cos-v1        384        512        English
#> 5  paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2        384        128  50+ languages
#> 6                      all-mpnet-base-v2        768        384        English
#> 7  paraphrase-multilingual-mpnet-base-v2        768        128  50+ languages
#> 8                      bge-small-en-v1.5        384        512        English
#> 9                       bge-base-en-v1.5        768        512        English
#> 10                 multilingual-e5-small        384        512 100+ languages
#> 11                 nomic-embed-text-v1.5        768       8192        English
#> 12           jina-embeddings-v2-small-en        512       8192        English
#> 13                  mxbai-embed-large-v1       1024        512        English
#> 14                        potion-base-8M        256    1000000        English
#>    size_mb
#> 1     90.9
#> 2    133.6
#> 3     69.5
#> 4     90.9
